task: Tap every value that is a decimal (float).

wrong_sets.why: "12.5" is in quotes, so it is text (str), not a number.
12.0 has a decimal point, so it is a decimal (float), not a whole number. Ending in .0 does not change that.

ok: A decimal has a decimal point and no quotes: 0.5, 12.0, 3.25, -12.0.
